description: F-HW-02b — countersink part fixture for /occt/op/hole/countersink wiring. Pure data: hole spec + termination + expected per-position metadata. Worker side is blocked in W3 (occt-worker task #31); this file pins the input/output shape for W4+ wiring.
notes: Worker side (/occt/op/hole/countersink) is blocked in W3 — wire-up in W4 once occt-worker src/ exists.
ISO 10642 metric flat-head defaults to 90° cone angle (spec §2.3 + §3.1). ANSI/UTS variant of this fixture would use 82°.
coneDiameter > diameter invariant: 13.44 > 6.6 — passes CSK_SMALLER_THAN_BORE validator gate.
Funnel depth derives from coneDiameter / (2·tan(coneAngle/2)) = 13.44 / 2 = 6.72 mm; rendered cosmetically by holeSectionSvg.computeHoleSectionSvg in the wizard Preview tab.
